# Abhee Pre Launch

> abheeprelaunch.com is run by Abhee Pre Launch, an authorised channel partner (not the developer) for Abhee Ventures residential projects in Bengaluru. It publishes project details, prices, RERA numbers, floor plans and buyer guides, and takes enquiries and site-visit requests.

Contact: info@abheeprelaunch.com · +91 80 4748 8993. Prices marked * are indicative and subject to change; RERA details can be verified at https://rera.karnataka.gov.in/.
